description: This file contains multiple functions that set up mock server expectations for request matching based on various criteria such as path, method, headers, query parameters, cookies, body content (including XML, JSON, XPath, regex), and response configurations. It appears to be an example or test script for configuring mock server responses with detailed request matching rules.
